title: World Model Control by Trajectory Reachability Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2605.22164v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Latent world models can learn representations that contain information needed for control, while the downstream controller may still rank candidate actions poorly when it relies on terminal latent distance alone. We study this failure in a fixed encoder and introduce trajectory reachability metrics (TRM), a small temporal pairwise cost trained from logged trajectories and used to rank predicted endpoints of a candidate action sequence against a goal. In the TwoRoom evaluation on 100 episodes from a high distance range, the original controller with LeWorldModel reaches 7.0% mean success. Temporal TRM trained after excluding all evaluation episodes reaches 96.7%, shuffled label controls stay at 0.0%, and TRM also improves PLDM from 32.7% to 84.0%. translated_title: 基于轨迹可达性度量的世界模型控制
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型能够学习包含控制所需信息的表示，但当下游控制器仅依赖终端潜在距离时，仍可能对候选动作给出糟糕的排序。我们在固定编码器的设置下研究了这种失败现象，并提出了轨迹可达性度量，这是一种从记录轨迹中训练的小型时间成对代价，用于根据目标对候选动作序列的预测终点进行排序。在来自高距离范围的100个回合的TwoRoom评估中，使用LeWorldModel的原始控制器仅达到7.0%的平均成功率；而在排除所有评估回合后训练的时间TRM达到了96.7%，打乱标签的对照组保持在0.0%，同时TRM还将PLDM的成功率从32.7%提升至84.0%。TopoNav这一独立的像素导航任务也展现了修复后的排序与闭环控制之间相同的联系。使用共享候选的选择审计（SASC）和行空间干预……
tldr: 论文提出轨迹可达性度量（TRM），一种从记录轨迹中训练的小型时间成对代价，用于修复潜在世界模型控制器仅依赖终端潜在距离导致的动作排序失败，将TwoRoom任务成功率从7.0%提升至96.7%，并验证了排序修复与闭环控制性能之间的直接联系。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Trajectory Reachability Metrics (TRM), a small temporal pairwise cost trained from logged trajectories to fix the action ranking failure of latent world model controllers that rely solely on terminal latent distance, boosting TwoRoom success from 7.0% to 96.7% and demonstrating a direct link between repaired ranking and closed-loop control performance.
